name: Wisconsin

flag.description: A dark blue field with the state coat of arms in the center, a shield held by a sailor and a miner with a badger on top and the motto "Forward", between "WISCONSIN" in white above and "1848" in white below.
flag.symbolism: The sailor and miner stand for work on water and land, the badger for the state nickname, and 1848 is the year of statehood.

hook: Wisconsin brackets its arms with WISCONSIN above and 1848 below, and a little badger sits on top of the shield.
trivia: The name and the date 1848 were added in 1981 to make the flag stand out from other blue state flags.
Wisconsin's nickname comes from early lead miners who lived in hillside dugouts, like badgers.
